description: Template để NHÓM tự viết đúng 10 case: 5 single-turn dùng query và 5 multi-turn dùng turns. Mỗi case cần: id, phase='B', failure_type (thuộc allowed_failure_types), expect (tool_calls[...] hoặc no_tool=true), và metadata.what_it_tests. File để trống có chủ đích vì mỗi nhóm phải tự thiết kế các case này.

cases.query: Extract 3 keywords from: AI safety research improves trustworthy systems.

args.text: AI safety research improves trustworthy systems.

metadata.what_it_tests: Explicit keyword extraction routes to the new local keywords tool and preserves the requested count.

cases.query: Find 2 research papers about retrieval augmented generation.

metadata.what_it_tests: Research-paper intent uses papers and extracts an explicit result limit.

cases.query: What is the internal policy on source citation?

metadata.what_it_tests: Internal-policy questions route to the local policy knowledge base.

cases.query: Read this arXiv paper for me.

metadata.what_it_tests: A paper-reading request without an arXiv URL or ID asks for the missing identifier.

cases.query: Find AI news today on the web and recent social posts about AI.

metadata.what_it_tests: Independent web-news and social-topic requests produce both required calls.

turns.content: Extract 5 keywords from AI governance and safety research.
Actually use this text: reliable robotics systems need safety testing.

args.text: reliable robotics systems need safety testing.

metadata.what_it_tests: Latest constraints override earlier text and count while retaining the keyword-extraction intent.

turns.content: Change the subject to graph neural networks.

metadata.what_it_tests: A corrected paper topic replaces the earlier topic while the prior result count carries over.

turns.content: Find climate technology news this week.
Search the web only, still for this week.

metadata.what_it_tests: Topic correction and timeframe carryover route to one web-news lookup.

turns.content: Show recent social posts about OpenAI.
Make them the most popular posts instead.
Keep the topic OpenAI and show 3.

metadata.what_it_tests: Social topic carries over, popularity selects Top, and the latest count is applied.

turns.content: Read this arXiv paper for me.

metadata.what_it_tests: After a missing paper URL is supplied, the final request reads that exact arXiv paper.
